provenance.source_quote: r or authorized agent shall first make application to the building official and obtain the required permit if they intend to: Alter Change the occupancy of Construct Demolish Enlarge Move Repair a building or structure The Permitting Process Before work on a project begins, a permit must be obtained by the property owner or licensed trade professional responsible for the project along with a complete list of subcontractors. Single Permits If the project involves a single licensed trade, such as electrical, plumbing, or heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) (mechanical) work, a single permit can be obtained. Contact Building Services for: Electrical Permit Gas Permit Mechanical Permit Plumbing Permit Building Permits If the project involves multiple licensed trades, then a Building Permit can be obtained which will cover all the licensed trades involved in the project. A building permit is also required for projects that involve structural work. Building Permit Application Variance or Conditional Use Permit Application Zoning Amendment Application Specialty Permits Certain commercial projects require special permits instead of or in addition to building permit
